mapper.select: SELECT a.*, au.nickname as admin_name FROM announcement a LEFT JOIN admin_user au ON a.admin_id = au.admin_id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT a.*, au.nickname as admin_name,
CASE WHEN uar.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS `read`
0 AS `read`
FROM announcement a LEFT JOIN admin_user au ON a.admin_id = au.admin_id
LEFT JOIN user_announcement_read uar ON uar.announcement_id = a.id AND uar.user_id = #{userId}
WHERE a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT a.*, au.nickname as admin_name,
CASE WHEN uar.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS `read`
0 AS `read`
FROM announcement a LEFT JOIN admin_user au ON a.admin_id = au.admin_id
LEFT JOIN user_announcement_read uar ON uar.announcement_id = a.id AND uar.user_id = #{userId}
WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.display_mode = 'popup' ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
SELECT a.*, au.nickname as admin_name FROM announcement a LEFT JOIN admin_user au ON a.admin_id = au.admin_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO announcement (title, content, type, status, display_mode, admin_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{status}, #{displayMode}, #{adminId})
mapper.update: UPDATE announcement SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, type = #{type}, status = #{status}, display_mode = #{displayMode} WHERE id = #{id}
